title: Daśa-vidha Nāmāparādha
author: Bengali composition by
Śrīla Bhakti Sundar Govinda Dev-Goswāmī Mahārāj
subtitle: The Ten Offences to the Holy Name

translation: Hare Kṛṣṇa Mahāmantra – of all mantras best,\
throughout the world is preached by saints’ potent grace behest;\
such saints to the Name devoted, such pure souls great:\
never dare offend them – never show them hate.
Lord Kṛṣṇa, son of Nanda, of all lords the Leader – \
the great Śiva and all the gods serve His feet forever;\
all-fulfilling Name of Kṛṣṇa glorious and great – \
His Pastimes, Nature, Form, also think not separate.
“Guru’s a form of Kṛṣṇa – the scriptures corroborate;\
in the form of Guru, Kṛṣṇa blesses the fortunate.”\
Never offend that Guru by thinking him mere mortal;\
gain your highest goal and serve the Name for time eternal.
The Vedas, Mother Gāyatrī, and *Śrīmad Bhāgavatam*\
illuminate the lotus feet of Śrī Harināma;\
whoever dares to vilify those holy Vedic scriptures – \
never keep their company, know them as offenders.

text: atistuti, hena kabhu nā bhāviha mane
translation: The glories of the Name – all scriptures’ exaltation;\
dare not think their praise to be exaggeration.\
Agastya, Ananta, Brahmā, Śiva, all forever\
sing the glories of that Name with full-hearted fervour.\
Who can cross the ocean of the glories of that Name?\
Whoever says ‘exaggeration’ have their sin to blame.
The Holy Names of Kṛṣṇa – supreme wealth of Goloka:\
who thinks those Names mundane, imagined – he is an offender.
All scriptures claim the Name all sin it can destroy,\
but those who spend their time in sin, making it a ploy – \
such a wicked attitude is that of an offender\
deceived by illusion, perpetually to suffer.

text: tā̐ra sama nā bhāviha śubha-karma ādi
translation: Incomparable Name of Kṛṣṇa – ocean of ecstasy:\
never dare compare it with auspicious piety.
Those who’re faithless t’ward the Name – deceived by Providence:\
giving them the Holy Name is surely an offence.

text: śuddha kṛṣṇa-nāma tāra kabhu nāhi sphure
translation: Though hearing glories infinite of Kṛṣṇa’s Holy Name,\
those whose hearts don’t melt in love are rascals of ill fame;\
only pride and avarice their thoughts and deeds do yield – \
the Pure Name of Kṛṣṇa is to them never revealed.
Casting off these ten offences, leaving no exception,\
those pure souls who chant the Name in Holy Congregation – \
the miracle of love for Kṛṣṇa they will surely savour,\
the Name Divine Himself will shine within their hearts forever.
